issues.reason: Measures & units stipulates that "a measure on a PLURAL subject is the group AGGREGATE ... it does NOT distribute to each member", so (Measure sk_shares_1 price 6.83 dollar) states that the whole block of shares is together worth $6.83 — false, since $6.83 is the per-share close.

The scale must be "the surface dimension" — a stated gradable adjective or dimension noun — and no word in "up 2 cents" supplies `increase`; the atom also states a static 2-cent magnitude for the shares where the text states a change from an unstated prior value, and inherits the same false group-aggregate reading.

gaps_confirmed: a change-over-time differential with an implicit prior value ("up 2 cents") — MoreBy needs two compared entities and there is no licensed "up/down N from the previous value" form
a per-unit value predicated of a plural ("shares ended at $6.83") — a measure on a plural is defined as the group aggregate and no distributive-measure form exists
new_gaps: a value-oblique on a change-of-state event ("ended AT $6.83") — preposition-named obliques take entity NPs, and there is no licensed way to put a magnitude+unit in an oblique's object slot, so the closing value cannot be attached to the ending event either

episodic bare-plural subject given a group witness ("Shares ended ...") — the determiner rule makes a bare plural the generic kind, so a specific-day episode about a company's shares has no specified encoding
repair_summary: Removed (Past (Measure sk_shares_1 price 6.83 dollar)) — false under the stipulated group-aggregate reading of a plural measure, with no licensed per-member measure form to replace it. Removed (Past (Measure sk_shares_1 increase 2 cent)) — the scale `increase` is supplied by no word in the sentence and a delta from an implicit prior value has no licensed carrier.
notes: Both removals cost real content (the sentence's whole point is the $6.83 close and the 2-cent rise), but the repair rule bars replacing a false atom with an invention, and the two registered gaps are exactly what a licensed fix would need: a distributive/per-unit measure form and a change-from-prior-value form. The retained atoms — group witness, Patient on the intransitive change-of-state `end`, (Weekday wednesday), Past — were untouched.
